card.name: Linking words in drug preparation instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words like "or", "after" and "be" in administration and preparation directions, right where the text offers an alternative or next step, such as sprinkling, dispersing, crushing or diluting.

modes.label: Alternatives in how to take
modes.description: "or" between ways of taking a dose, such as whole or sprinkled, or intact or opened.
modes.example: can be taken with or without food, whole<< or>> sprinkled on applesauce; do not

modes.label: Preparation wording
modes.description: "be" or "after" in dilution and reconstitution directions.
modes.example: can be administered intravenously without further dilution or may<< be>> mixed with diluents listed below.
